summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue of `ax.bar` raising an exception when passed only NaN data. It introduces a default return value of `np.nan` in case no finite value is found, which should prevent the `StopIteration` error.

issues.description: The patch is narrowly scoped to the specific case of handling NaN values, which may not cover other potential edge cases or similar issues.
The patch introduces a slight deviation from the original code style by using parentheses around the generator expression, which is not necessary but consistent with PEP 8.
